map.输入：标称 SPF50、实测用量约为推荐值一半 → 实际防护约等于 SPF15–: Input: labelled SPF50, measured amount about half the recommended → actual protection is roughly at the SPF15-20 level; advise applying enough or reapplying.
map.SPF 越高越久不用补吗？: Does higher SPF mean you can skip reapplication longer?
map.不是。SPF 是强度不是时长，出汗、摩擦、出油都会削弱，一般 2 小时补一次。: No. SPF is an intensity, not a duration; sweat, friction and oil weaken it, so reapply about every 2 hours.
map.PA 和 SPF 区别？: What is the difference between PA and SPF?
map.SPF 主要防 UV-B（晒伤），PA 主要防 UV-A（光老化和黑），两者都要: SPF mainly blocks UV-B (sunburn); PA mainly blocks UV-A (photo-aging and tanning). Both matter.
map.面部常见推荐约 1/4 茶匙，多数人实际只涂到 1/4–1/2，防护大打折扣。: The common facial recommendation is about 1/4 teaspoon, but most people actually apply only 1/4-1/2, greatly reducing protection.
